description: School Bus Services Routes (PTA-004) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Public Transport Authority. Current school bus routes within Western Australia. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Public Transport Authority. Its tags are Harvested, bus, route, school. It offers 7 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage, shp. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
